request.description: ONE small wall-mounted dungeon torch sconce for a 2D SIDE-VIEW battleground. Native pixel art on transparent64x64 canvas; the actual small prop should be roughly20px wide by42px tall, centered with ample transparent padding. Distinctive dark cool-iron basket cradle with two chunky horizontal bands, short curved wall bracket and diamond-shaped backplate beneath. A compact lively orange flame with a pale warm-yellow connected heart above it. Flat frontal side-scroller presentation, no isometric platform, no background wall or external glow. Clear complete silhouette; no floating sparks, smoke, gradient halo, tiny scratch noise, blur or antialiasing. Keep 2–3 connected tones per material, muted blue-gray iron with sparse top-left rim highlights; warm orange/amber/yellow flame. Readable charming dungeon prop consistent with the approved chunky cast. No text, no ornate baroque filigree; premium through shape and deliberate clusters.
